Imagined Dragons World Tour is an achievement earned by ensuring that all members of the raid group possess all four Dream Essences before defeating the Dragons of Nightmare encounter in the Emerald Nightmare on Normal difficulty or higher. Located around the encounter room are four portals that lead to four specific locations away from the instance. When a player enters a portal, they gain a Dream Essence buff unique to that portal. To obtain the achievement, all members of the raid must have entered every portal at least once, thereby gaining all four the Dream Essences, before the encounter is defeated. Improved Aspect of the Hawk increases ranged haste by 3/6/9/12/15% based on number of talent points spent. Useful skill in endgame raiding as every auto shot fired has a chance to substantially increase DPS for a period of time. The haste buff stacks with Rapid Fire (Classic), and as such many hunters elect to sure both these skills at the same time for a short period of high DPS.

The Imperial Seat is located inside Blackrock Depths, and is the innermost chamber of the instance. It is the throne room of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan, and home to the Shadowforge Senate and Twilight's Hammer ambassadors. This large room has many mixed groups of dwarves, with the Emperor and Princess Moira Bronzebeard sitting at the end. The room must be cleared before engaging the Emperor, as he will call them all to his aid when he aggros. The princess is a dedicated healer; if the players are attempting the quests The Fate of the Kingdom or The Royal Rescue, she must be kept alive until the Emperor is killed. The Imperial Granary can be found just south of Halfhill in south-central Valley of the Four Winds. The granary supplies the Stormstout Brewery with much of its grain, but has been having trouble thanks to sprites, that were accidentally brought in through cheaply purchased grain, and other wildlife from the Plain of Thieves. The granary is run by Grainlord Kai and his assistant Grainer Pan. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, demons attacked the granary, looting and setting the grain in felflame. Sent by the Monkey King, the Grandmaster of the Order of the Broken Temple arrived here to retrieve some grain.

Impressive Influence is a reputation buff applied to all player characters that increases rep gain with Legion and Battle for Azeroth factions. It was announced on April 17, 2020 and scheduled to run from April 20 through May 18, 2020. Like the Winds of Wisdom buff, it was made to help during the . The reputation buff was extended to last through May 21 while MOTHER's vendor offerings were being adjusted. It returned September 1, 2020 and lasted through that month, this time also including the patch 8.3.0 factions. However, the rep buff was re-enabled the afternoon of October 1, 2020 and the original September announcement post changed to state "through the month of October".

Imprisoned Essences are urns located in Perdition Hold in the Maw.
Imp's Cup is a common archaeology artifact that requires ?? Demonic Archaeology Fragments to solve, and allows use of ?? keystones. Using it turns it into a Restored Artifact.
__NOTOC__ Impling Pillagers are imps located in the Temple of the Jade Serpent during The Trial at the Temple.
Impatient Merchants are pandaren located in the cooking scenario in Halfhill Market.
Impatient Farmhands are pandaren located in the cooking scenario in Halfhill Market.
Impressing Zo'Sorg is a player vs. player achievement earned by completing certain PVP world quests 20 times each.
Impossibly Oversized Mitts are dropped by Sludgefist in Castle Nathria.
Implacable Weatherproof Treads are dropped by the P.O.S.T. Master in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Imonar's Demi-Gauntlets drop from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne.

The Imp Summoning Scroll would have taught warlocks how to summon an imp. Ultimately the item was never made available, and the spell Summon Imp was learned as a reward from the following quests: *Beginnings *Piercing the Veil *The Stolen Tome *Vile Familiars *Windows to the Source
Immaculate Living Mushroom drops from Brackenspore in Highmaul.
Imposing Dreadsoul Headgear drops from Mephistroth in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Impenetrable Garothi Breastplate drops from Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Immovable Stance of the Vombata drops from Sorranos just south of Haven in Zereth Mortis.
Imperious Vambraces drop from Zul, Reborn in Uldir. They are also looted from Cache of Uldir Treasures.
Imperial Archivists are venthyr located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
